feedback.problem: What is the complex conjugate of $z=2+8\text{i}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the complex conjugate, we flip the sign of the imaginary part.

In the given number $z=2+8\text{i},$ the imaginary part is $8\text{i}.$ Flipping the sign, we get $-8\text{i}.$

Therefore, the complex conjugate is given by $\overset{―}{z}=2-8\text{i}.$
